chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
"The first act of goodness a man shows to his child is to name him with a good name, so let one of you improve the name of his child."

key_terms.يَبَرُّ: to do good to / to show kindness (birr)

ai.seo_question: What is the first duty of a father towards his child according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies naming as the foundational act of *birr* (kindness/piety) a father extends to his child, establishing a spiritual and social identity. This teaching underscores the significance of names in Shia tradition as a source of dignity and connection to the Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the Prophet's practice of choosing names with good meanings. It serves as a practical guideline for parents to begin their parental duties with this essential act of care.
